text:
eva: kicking off bring-up for v4.0-int4 (onboard build bld-206). preliminary composite quality score down ~2.7% vs prod-v3.3. starting scoped canary, want quick consensus on auto-fallback rule.

mike: paste the smoke/eval numbers?

lina: smoke snapshot attached (smk-20260323-22):
```
baseline: prod v3.3 (bld-193)
candidate: v4.0-int4 (bld-206)
metrics sample: N=25k for search, N=8k longdoc, N=10k rerank
primary metrics:
  composite_quality (BLEU*0.3 + MRR*0.4 + rerankP@10*0.3): 0.754 -> 0.734 (delta -2.65%)
  longdoc_MRR: 0.255 -> 0.247 (delta -3.1%, p=0.022)
  rerank_precision@10: 0.421 -> 0.410 (delta -2.6%, p=0.07)
  latency_p95: 140ms -> 115ms (improvement)
```

jeorge: interesting latency win but longdoc MRR drop is >3% and p<0.05. that alone should block wide rollout per our SLOs.

eva: proposal: two-tier auto-fallback logic:
  1) immediate rollback if any primary metric has delta <= -3% AND p<=0.05
  2) soft-guard if composite_quality delta <= -2% for 4h rolling window -> cap at 1% quiet-burn and escalate to oncall
  3) route pinning for rerank-critical routes (keep prod v3.3) during the quiet-burn

mike: also propose a statistical smoothing guard: compute EWMA on composite delta with alpha=0.2; if EWMA crosses -1.5% for 30m -> trigger backup. helps with noisy short-term spikes.

metrics-bot: eval smk-20260323-22 posted: composite delta -2.65% (95% CI [-3.4%, -1.9%]), longdoc_MRR -3.1% (p=0.022), rerankP@10 -2.6% (p=0.07).

lina: based on that CI, composite signal looks reliably below -2%. i'm leaning rollback, but we could do one cautious pattern: 6h A/B at 2% traffic targeted to longdoc+search, with structured logging of top-5 tokens and click concordance. if any rule in eva/mike triggers, immediate rollback.

eva: example route pin JSON for ops to apply:
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match": "route:search.rerank", "pin": "v3.3"},
    {"match": "route:longdoc.*", "traffic": {"v4.0-int4": 0.02, "v3.3": 0.98}}
  ],
  "guards": {
    "immediate": {"metric": "longdoc_MRR", "delta": -0.03, "p": 0.05},
    "rolling": {"metric": "composite_quality", "delta": -0.02, "window_mins": 240}
  }
}
```

ci-bot: canary prep OK. smoke artifact smk-20260323-22 archived at gs://rwd-inference-smokes/smk-20260323-22.tar.gz

mike: approved the 6h A/B @2% but require ops to set route pin and EWMA alert. jorge please sign off?

jorge: sign-off granted. add offline concordance job to compute user-click agreement on first 5k longdocs. also request top-100 discrepancy examples for model triage.

eva: ops-bot can you schedule the canary for 2026-03-24T06:00Z and attach the guard config above?

ops-bot: scheduled canary smk-20260323-22 at 2026-03-24T06:00Z. guard config saved as rollout-config-4981234567.json. notifications to #eng-ml and #release-war-room.

lina: i'll instrument EWMA alert and the concordance job now, will post dashboard links before run. thanks team.

mike: one more note 1 1: add a manual "opt-in promote" for customers using dedicated mode; don't auto-promote on Dedicated until 2x longer observation window.

eva: added to rollout policy. closing thread for now.
